correctness.rationale: In PG(2,3), four lines cover 13 points exactly only if they form a concurrent pencil. At the four-point lower bound, all four rational tangent lines are distinct, with one contact on each. Independently enumerated 189 fixed-center patterns, all associated linear systems rank 8 in 15 quartic coefficients, 378 uniquely normalized candidate quartics passing full rational incidence. Applied exact Gröbner unit-ideal tests for gradients on X=1,Y=1,Z=1 to check smoothness over algebraic closure, not just F3; exactly 234 smooth candidates. Independently constructed all 432 projective matrices stabilizing the center and found three orbits of sizes 18,72,144. Transitivity over 13 centers gives exactly 3042 total forms and full orbit sizes 234,936,1872 with stabilizers 24,6,3. Entire finite field and group classification was independently re-enumerated, not inferred from repository log.
